河南省发展和改革委员会关于调整工商业分时电价有关事项的通知

notes: TOU periods per 河南省发改委《关于调整工商业分时电价有关事项的通知》豫发改价管〔2024〕283号 (2024-05-29, effective 2024-06-01; cited in note 2 of every notice in the window; reposted on 95598.cn 2026-09-01): 1、2、12月 峰 16-24 (尖峰 17-19 in 1、12月), 谷 0-7; 3-5、9-11月 峰 16-24, 谷 0-6、11-14; 6-8月 峰 16-24 (尖峰 20-23 in 7、8月), 谷 0-7; other hours 平. No 深谷.

Float per 283号: 峰:平:谷 = 1.72 : 1 : 0.45, 尖峰 = 1.2 × the 峰 float, applied to (代理购电价格 + 输配电价); a 2026-01 DRC 征求意见稿 proposed that 输配电价 of 代理购电 users stop floating, and the TOU spread's dependence on 输配电价 indeed varies between notices. Prices are stored exactly as printed; 尖峰 only where printed (1、7、8、12月).

Sources: 2025-11..2026-08 parsed as text from the identical notice reposted by 平顶山市人民政府 (pds.gov.cn 价格收费, watermarked PDF); 2025-11, 2025-12, 2026-09, 2026-10 OCR'd from the 95598.cn PDF (outlined glyphs, no text layer) and cross-validated against the notice arithmetic.
